labeling_rule: This artifact is a frozen protocol. It contains no results and must never be cited as evidence of an empirical outcome. Domain and source commitments recorded here are minimums to be satisfied by a future lawful execution, not counts of anything executed.
issue_binding: SzeChunYiu/ORION#1086 P10: populate the frozen design — four domains, 100 tasks/domain, 80 known-method controls; evaluate execution boxes; CANNOT_CHECK with precise reasons, never silent skips

protocol_freeze_binding.relation: This artifact supplies the domain/source/license layer under the frozen H1-H6 design. It does not modify, reinterpret or discharge any H1-H6 gate. Where the two disagree, the H1-H6 freeze wins.
protocol_freeze_binding.note: required_inputs.protected_task_manifest stays partially supplied: this freeze fixes the four domains, their public sources and their licence statuses, but the per-task ID enumeration (100 verifier-backed tasks per domain) requires the pinned downloads and is NOT_POPULATED here.

license.reason: The upstream openai/miniF2F repository exposes no licence file detectable by the GitHub licence API at verification time (API returns Not Found; fetch sha256 e80d8bd80b672a912a514abede3950704d7e2e93c561917510b5150e5889971a; repository itself exists, last push recorded 2023-08-16). Maintained mirrors do carry licences — facebookresearch/miniF2F MIT, google-deepmind/miniF2F Apache-2.0, yangky11/miniF2F-lean4 MIT (search-API evidence fetch sha256 c1cf42a340149f08f7e87283b24e1dcce86347aac88d9b4649a82b9bb6963bf4) — but a mirror's licence does not license the upstream original. Task content (competition/olympiad problem statements) carries separate rights that no repository licence covers.
license.selection_rule: Before any download, pin exactly one miniF2F distribution and verify ITS licence with URL and date; downloading from openai/miniF2F as-is is forbidden under this freeze.

non_bypass_boundaries: Licence verification precedes download for every source; nothing in this artifact has been downloaded or executed.
A CANNOT_CHECK licence is never upgraded by mirror adjacency, elapsed time or inaction; only new explicit evidence upgrades it.
The committed minimums are not executed counts; reporting them as achieved counts is a protocol violation.
Changing domains, sources, minimums, arms or box verdicts after any H1-H6 data collection is forbidden and requires a new versioned freeze with a new identity.
No weak proxy may replace an unavailable comparator arm; unavailable arms stay CANNOT_CHECK in every report.
